title: Your GHL CRM: From Manual Follow-Ups to Leads That Move on Their Own

sections.label: 1 - CAPTURE AND ORGANIZE EVERY LEAD
sections.note: Lead capture and contact management share this section. Your forms feed GHL directly, and tags and custom fields sort each contact as it arrives.

sections.label: 2 - KEEP THE PIPELINE UP TO DATE
sections.note: Each lead becomes an opportunity in your pipeline, and what the lead does moves it between stages. We map the stages from how your team sells today.

sections.label: 3 - FOLLOW UP AND NURTURE AUTOMATICALLY
sections.note: Every message depends on what the lead has done, and a reply or a booking stops the automated ones. Texts only deliver once your GHL number is registered for business texting.

sections.label: 4 - TASKS AND ALERTS FOR YOUR TEAM
sections.note: Task assignments and notifications share this section. Your team is told who to call and when, based on lead activity and pipeline stage.

sections.label: 5 - TEST IT AND HAND IT TO YOUR TEAM
sections.note: Every workflow is tested with test leads before it touches a real one. Everything is named and organized so your team can manage it.

nodes.label: 1 - A new lead fills in your GHL form and lands in the CRM without anyone typing it
2 - GHL tags the lead by source and fills in your custom fields automatically
3 - If that email or phone is already in GHL, the existing contact gets updated instead
4 - The lead is added to the first stage of your pipeline as a new opportunity
5 - When the lead replies, books or goes quiet, the stage changes on its own
6 - GHL sends the lead a text and an email right away from your business
7 - If the lead has not replied, a nurture sequence keeps in touch until they do
8 - When a lead replies or books, GHL assigns a call task to the right person
9 - Your team gets a notification when a lead changes stage or needs attention
10 - We run test leads through every form, stage and message before going live
11 - Each workflow is named and filed in folders so your team can find and edit it
12 - Your team works every lead from the pipeline instead of tracking it by hand

input_sample.message: Looking for a quote. When can someone call me?

output_sample.notification: Sent to the assigned team member in the GHL app
